# Tsar Bomba

> > Luxury automatic and quartz watches featuring Miyota movements, 316L stainless steel construction, sapphire crystals, and customizable modular designs.

Tsar Bomba (TSAR BOMBA LLC) specializes in high-end timepieces with signature collections including Elemental, Dark Matter, Nucleus Femme, and Chivalry series. The brand emphasizes watch customization through interchangeable straps, bezels, and modular components, with headquarters in Irvine, California.

## Key Topics

- Miyota Movement
- 316L Stainless Steel
- Sapphire Crystal
- Automatic Watches
- Luxury Timepieces
- Watch Customization
- Nucleus Femme Collection
- Dark Matter Series
- Elemental Collection
- Skeletonized Dial
- Cubic Zirconia
- Deployant Clasp
- Water Resistant Watches
- Women's Watches
